title: Cancel an appointment
summary: Cancel with the right reason: in advance, late, by the doctor, without notice, by the clinic or other.

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows appointments by room and doctor.

steps.title: Right-click the appointment
steps.details: The appointment menu opens. If you don't see it, change the day with the arrows or use Find appointment.

steps.title: Change status
steps.details: Hover over Change status to see the statuses.

steps.title: Choose the reason
steps.details: In advance: they let you know ahead of time. Late: they let you know at the last minute. By the doctor: the doctor cancels it. Under Cancel… you'll find without notice, by the clinic and Other reason (with a note). The reason stays in the history and in the cancellation reports.

steps.title: Cancellation note
steps.details: Only with Other reason: explain why it's being canceled.
